modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: On StarFlyer's Japan domestic flights you may carry on 1 personal item.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: Up to 1 item per person (such as a handbag, camera or umbrella), a total of 115 cm or less in 3 dimensions (55 cm × 40 cm × 25 cm). Japan domestic flights.

carryon_weight.value: Up to 10 kg. Japan domestic flights.
